newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says it will readily extradite ETA members.
newsitem.headline: France says it will readily extradite ETA members.

text.p: Justice Minister Elisabeth Guigou said on Wednesday France would extradite members of the Basque ETA separatist group to Spain without hesitation if asked to do so.

"This was a terrible murder," Guigou said of the shooting to death by ETA guerrillas of Miguel Angel Blanco, a 29-year-old town councillor in northern Spain. The killing sparked huge protests across Spain.
"If the Spaniards now ask that we extradite certain (ETA) people, I will do it without any sort of hesitation after terrorist acts of this sort," she told Europe-1 radio.
ETA has traditionally used areas of southwest France as a base for attacks across the Spanish border despite French police crackdowns against the group.

French justice, however, has sometimes been slow to extradite suspected ETA members possibly because of revelations Spanish police may have been behind "death squads" that assassinated ETA sympathisers in France.
